% Independent Tectonic observations for integer expansion and format meanings.
\documentclass{article}
\typeout{PYTEXML active=\number\active}
\let\savedactive\active
{\chardef\active=11 \typeout{PYTEXML inner_active=\number\active}}
\typeout{PYTEXML restored_active=\number\active}
\typeout{PYTEXML copied_active=\number\savedactive}
\def\identity#1{#1}\def\sign{--+}
\chardef\value=\sign\identity{'17}
\typeout{PYTEXML expanded_octal=\number\value}
\def\args{64=11}
{\catcode\args\relax\typeout{PYTEXML supplied_operands=\number\catcode64}}
\def\index{64}\def\quantity{\catcode\index}
\chardef\value=\quantity
\typeout{PYTEXML internal_value=\number\value}
\def\x{BAD}\def\rawvalue{`\x}
\chardef\value=\rawvalue\relax
\typeout{PYTEXML raw_backtick=\number\value}
\def\grab#1{\ifcat#1a\typeout{PYTEXML lookahead=LETTER}\else\typeout{PYTEXML lookahead=OTHER}\fi}
\def\digits{11}
{\afterassignment\grab\catcode64=\digits @}
\def\digits{11 }
{\afterassignment\grab\catcode64=\digits @}
\def\gobble#1{}
\def\numeric{99}
\afterassignment\gobble\chardef\value=12\noexpand\numeric
\typeout{PYTEXML noexpand_terminator=\number\value}
\chardef\value\noexpand\numeric
\typeout{PYTEXML optional_equals_reexpands=\number\value}
\def\equals{=}\chardef\value\equals13
\typeout{PYTEXML expanded_equals=\number\value}
\def\value{9}\afterassignment\gobble\chardef\value=12\value
\typeout{PYTEXML provisional_relax=\number\value}
